description: Expected results of scanning the Czech fixture e-shop (generated by generate_site.py, country cz). In Czechia the tool checks only what ČOI fines and mandatory information: consumer reviews and the legal pages. Environmental claims (EmpCo) are not yet law in Czechia and the other blacklist points are switched off, so their planted sentences must stay without findings. Paths are relative to the fixture base URL. Pages that are not listed as without findings may have additional findings.

findings.text: Za hodnocení 5 hvězdičkami vám vrátíme 100 Kč.
Všechny recenze jsou od ověřených zákazníků.
